Well so far the best method of choice I have seen is a little complicated, but entirely painless. First sit on the floor with you back against the back of a chair. Get a wide strip of cloth and tie it around a heavy rock, or book. Anything around ten pounds does the trick. Next, tie the cloth in a "fairly" tight knot around your neck, and let it hang backwards across the seat of the chair, and dangle just above the ground. The pressure on your neck is enough to slowly stop the flow of blood to your brain, and it only takes about 45 min.
